history.perspective: B30 - Asset loading fallback (icons, interrupted offline audio downloads)
history.outcome: GAP FOUND AND FIXED: an interrupted audio download leaves a truncated file at the final path (expo-file-system streams directly to destination, no temp+rename, and this version's File API has no move method at all). has()/localUrl() only check existence not validity, so a corrupt file looked permanently 'downloaded'. Fixed by cleaning up dest on a caught failure; added a regression test distinct from the existing clean-failure test. Honest residual gap noted: can't catch a hard process kill, and a pre-existing corrupt file (from before this fix, or from that uncatchable case) would still be silently trusted - documented as a known limitation, not over-engineered around.
